observations: Single photo shows a PS4-shaped console box/unit wrapped in a custom Liverpool FC branded skin (red, Liverpool crest, text 'EST:1892', 'You'll Never Walk Alone').
No controllers, no game discs, no cables, no power brick, and no accessories are visible in this photo.
Console is shown closed with a 'SHOW GAMES' watermark overlay, not a screenshot of the actual gameplay or power-on state.
Shape and size appear consistent with a PS4 Fat ('big') body style, but the custom skin fully covers any model/serial plate.

identity.kind: PS4 console (Fat/'big' body style, customized skin)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a console shape consistent with PS4 Fat, but the skin covers the model plate so size/model cannot be confirmed.
No game discs or digital library screen shown in photo 0.
No cables, power brick, or accessory bundle visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (overheating, disc drive issues, HDD failure) common in used/hacked PS4 units.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on, displaying the PS4 home screen, and loading a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Claimed 2 controllers, 7 games, and 'complete accessories' may not actually be included or may be in poor condition.
risks.proof: A photo showing the console together with both controllers, the 7 game discs/cases, and all cables/power brick laid out.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare console only, no accessories

risks.risk: Custom skin may be hiding cosmetic damage, a different/older model, or a disc-swapped/modified unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the console with the skin peeled back or removed, showing the model/serial plate underneath.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unverified PS4 Fat, no premium for condition

risks.risk: 'Customized' could mean a modded/jailbroken system (common in this market per comparables) which carries legal/warranty risk and potential instability.
risks.proof: Screenshot of system settings/firmware version or confirmation from seller with a clear photo of the home menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced same as standard hacked PS4 listings, no premium

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on, showing the PS4 home screen and a game loading.
Photo of both controllers, all 7 games, and full accessory set laid out next to the console.
Photo with the skin peeled back or a shot of the rear/side ports and serial/model sticker.
Confirmation shot of system software/firmware screen to verify hack status and stability.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a customized PS4 console by type and body style, but every bundled claim (controllers, games, accessories, working condition) is unverified from the single photo, so it must be priced as a bare, unverified-working PS4 console at the low end of the comparable market.
